name: SatNet LEO Group 28
location_str: Commercial LC-1 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
slot_a_text: A batch of 9 Low Earth Orbit communication satellites for the Chinese state owned SatNet constellation operated by the China Satellite Network Group. The constellation will eventually consists of 13000 satellites.
slot_b_text: Commercial LC-1 has flown 15 launches since its first in 2025, 9 of them this year. The pad had 31 days to reset after the last one.
description: A batch of 9 Low Earth Orbit communication satellites for the Chinese state owned SatNet constellation operated by the China Satellite Network Group. The constellation will eventually consists of 13000 satellites.
rocket_fact: Some rocket engines can restart in space, allowing one launch to send satellites into several different orbits.
